best.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a clean fun-sized window for Safe fun, Medium confidence: 0.9-1.2 m, 536 kJ, 11 s period, very consistent 100/100, and good wind at 25 km/h.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches; 10-13s at mid tide gives the sheltered bay workable wrap-around lines.  Watch: gusts over 45 km/h add chop risk.
